probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
1. (Currently amended) A method for synchronous triggering of events in multiple modules, each module receiving a serial bit stream over a respective communications link, each said communications link comprising a data out and a clock line, each said clock line derived from a single clock source, the method comprising the steps of: transmitting a send packet over said data out line to each module synchronous with said clock source wherein said send packet contains at least one bit position defined as a trigger bit and triggering __a waveform-related__ event in a respective one of said modules upon receipt of a respective one of said at least one trigger bit.

2. (Currently amended) A method as recited in claim 1 wherein said triggering an event comprises waveform digitization.

3. (Previously presented) A method as recited in claim 1 wherein said triggering an event comprises waveform synthesis.

4. (Currently amended) A method as recited in claim 1 said communications link further comprising a data in line and further comprising receiving a serial bit stream over said data in line comprising a receive packet from each said module, wherein a predefined bit in each said receive packet comprises an indication that __said waveform-related__ measurement is triggered.

5. (Currently amended) A method as recited in claim 4 wherein said receive packet from each module further comprises a plurality of bits reflecting synchronous results of said triggered measurement.

11. (Currently amended) An apparatus for performing synchronous triggering of events in multiple modules comprising a housing comprising a controller and receiving two or more modules, a respective serial communications link between said controller and each of said two or more modules, each said communications link comprising a data out and a clock line, each said clock line derived from a single clock source, means for transmitting a send packet over said data out line to each module synchronous with said clock source wherein said send packet contains at least one bit position defined as a trigger bit, and means in each said module for triggering a __waveform-related__ module specific event upon receipt of respective ones of said trigger bits.

12. (Currently amended) An apparatus as recited in claim 11 wherein one of said events comprises waveform digitization.

13. (Currently amended) An apparatus as recited in claim 11 wherein one of said events comprises waveform digitization [[and waveform synthesis on separate channels of said module]].

14. (Currently amended) An apparatus as recited in claim 11 said communications link further comprising a data in line and further comprising means for receiving a serial bit stream over said data in line comprising a receive packet from each said module, wherein a predefined bit in each said receive packet comprises an indication that __said waveform-related__ measurement is triggered.

15. (Currently amended) An apparatus as recited in claim 14 wherein said receive packet from each module further comprises a plurality of bits reflecting synchronous results of said triggered measurement.

16. (Previously presented) An apparatus as recited in claim 11 wherein one of said events comprises waveform synthesis.
